The sleep is a `CALL_SPACING_S = 0.25` constant, a bit over the 0.2s minimum that 5 requests per second allows. The loop makes 4 calls, so this adds about 1s to the test.

I also saved the rate limit to EngramDB as a hazard note, so future sandbox tests get throttled too.
